question: Will Dubai International Airport handle more than 1.5 million passengers between October 1 and October 7, 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if Dubai International Airport (DXB) officially reports handling more than 1,500,000 total passengers strictly after 2026-09-30T20:00:00Z and at or before 2026-10-07T20:00:00Z (i.e., covering the October 1–7, 2026 period).
- "No": Wins if Dubai International Airport (DXB) officially reports handling 1,500,000 or fewer total passengers strictly after 2026-09-30T20:00:00Z and at or before 2026-10-07T20:00:00Z (i.e., covering the October 1–7, 2026 period).

Clarifications:
- The passenger count refers to total passengers handled (arrivals plus departures) as reported in official traffic statistics published by Dubai Airports for the period strictly after 2026-09-30T20:00:00Z and at or before 2026-10-07T20:00:00Z.
